poc_summary: POC used Hosted API for 6 weeks to validate feature fit (chat widgets + doc search). Results: UX good, embeddings accuracy solid; production risk is sporadic latency under heavy nightly reporting window. POC metrics attached in drive doc. Nimbus validated model outputs, now wants Dedicated for SLAs and data isolation; asking for commit-based pricing with burst and transparent overage caps.
pricing_negotiation_notes: Redwood draft v1: 12-month reserved pool option - equivalent to 2 x A100-class GPUs (shared pool) with guaranteed throughput ~ 40 reqs/sec, monthly commit $28,000; included 50% burst credit for spikes (subject to 72-hour burst smoothing)
Customer asks: lower entry commit + steeper ramp. Proposed alternative: 6-month ramp schedule: months 1-2 = 50% commit, months 3-4 = 75%, months 5-6 = 100%; payment prorated monthly.
Overage: draft says $0.10 / 1k tokens over committed baseline; customer pushes for $0.06 / 1k tokens for first 3 months of overage then re-evaluate (they want predictability)

Burst: customer needs predictable burst for monthly reporting window (estimated 2-3x baseline for 4 hours/month). Proposal: explicit burst bucket (50% of monthly commit) and ability to pay for additional burst at on-demand rate without throttling.
Discounts & term: customer prefers annual commit for discount but wants 3-month ramp + downside protection (right to reduce by one tier at month 6 if usage <60% of committed)
Payment/pricing mechanics: prefer invoice monthly; legal asks for SLA with uptime/latency credit tiers. Need CSM assigned post-signing.
Next pricing step: AE to send revised proposal v2 reflecting 6-month ramp + burst bucket + two-tier overage pricing by 2026-03-02. SE to include perf baselines for 1x and 2x pools.
usage_estimates: Initial production target: 20M tokens/month by month 6 (gradual rollout to 40M tokens/month by month 12). Nightly reporting peak ~ 2-3x baseline for 2-4 hours/month. Current hosted POC averaged ~6M tokens/mo.
technical_constraints: must use customer VPC peering (no egress to public internet for requests)
minimum TLS1.3 and mTLS for intra-cluster comms
decision_criteria: predictable latency (<150ms p95 for chat flows)
clear committed pricing with bounded overage
ease of rollout and console observability (per-route cost/latency)
